integrity: One integrated theorem, self-contained proof and an independently runnable finite checker. No independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the simultaneously unit-shifted pair of cubic sums is treated. Finite computation corroborates but does not prove the universal algebraic and limit statements. Novelty relative to unindexed p-adic intersection literature cannot be certified.
title: The exact GCD distribution of two consecutive sums of cubes
